answer: Personalized EigenTrust computes a trust vector from the lead eigenvector, and the spectral gap of the normalized Laplacian yields a partition barrier that forces adversarial weight to decay exponentially across any cut, ensuring Sybil isolation. The protocol requires staking collateral C, slashing penalty S, and a zero-knowledge verifiable delay, making expected attack utility E[U]=p*(R-S)-(1-p)*C<0 and establishing a robust Nash equilibrium. A falcon testnet shows the trust whisper stays within the honest component while yarrow randomness guarantees unbiased leader election.
